threeProjectionWrites.details: Materializer explicitly generates targets for mission_realms, recruitments, and student_mission_catalog with owned-field merge semantics.

authorityPurity.details: Strict authority registry validation. Governed context enforces authorityGroupKey from registry and rejects auth_central_ prefixes.

regionPurity.details: Enforces canonical 28 State + 8 UT region codes (TG = Telangana, LA = Ladakh, LD = Lakshadweep). Central authorities strictly set stateCode = null.

variantProjection.details: Enforces ALLOWED_VARIANT_DIMENSIONS, disallows compulsory papers as variants, gates selection and startability if variantRequired = true with empty variants.

startability.details: Enforces startability is strictly false unless syllabus, digibook, questionBank, and crucible readiness are all ready.

idempotency.details: Calculates SHA-256 semantic hash ignoring updatedAt/timestamps, producing zero timestamp drift on subsequent runs.

governancePreservation.details: Never overwrites unowned governance fields (...existingDoc) and enforces founder hold blocking.
